title: Chiarella 2024 mindfulness cheek PPS
citation: Chiarella, S. G., De Pastina, R., Raffone, A., & Simione, L. (2024). Mindfulness affects the boundaries of bodily self-representation: The effect of focused-attention meditation in fading the boundary of peripersonal space. Behavioral Sciences 14, 306.
notes: The preview preserves the five known tactile timings in each pre/post assessment. Twelve untimed endpoint probes per assessment remain documented.

reported_source.type: Pink noise on two loudspeakers with opposing level envelopes.

reported_tactile_response.device: Digitimer DS7A with a neurological tip electrode
reported_tactile_response.response: Press the spacebar promptly when touch is detected.

reference_parameters.inspection_scope: Two 50-trial timing subsets with 30 paired trials and 20 audio-only catches each. No times are substituted for T0 and T6. The 15-minute meditation is an experimenter-delivered interval around the assessments. Audio and touch are software markers.
implementation_gaps: Original two-speaker pink-noise files, calibrated sound gain functions and exact acoustic calibration are unavailable.
Exact before-sound and after-sound tactile probe offsets, response deadline and separate intertrial interval are unreported.
Electrode and electrical stimulator delivery mode and calibration are unresolved. A synchronized apparatus and physical timing validation are needed.

provenance.field: Speaker geometry, electrical pulse, timers and response
Fixed intervention order, instructions and analysis
